name: Veralto
description: Veralto sells the instruments, chemicals and software that measure and treat water and that mark, code and design product packaging. About 61% of its sales are recurring (consumables such as reagents and inks, spare parts, services and software), because each installed instrument or printer keeps pulling in refills and service. Water Quality (Hach, Trojan Technologies, ChemTreat) sells to municipal utilities and industrial plants; Product Quality & Innovation (Videojet, Linx, Esko, X-Rite, Pantone) sells to consumer-goods, food and pharmaceutical makers. Despite the Industrials / Environmental Services label it is mostly an installed-base instruments-and-consumables company with a 59.9% gross margin, not a waste or facilities-services business.

That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 3825 (Instruments for Measuring & Testing of Electricity & Electrical Signals) per EDGAR.
